findings.detail: Eight distinct eligible current-period schedule positions are present in source but absent from pipeline output.

rationale: Class 2 source-row adjudication. The March 31, 2026 schedule contains the flagged Albion term loan; three Jupiter Canada facilities; Ruby term and delayed-draw loans; and Urban Gym term and delayed-draw loans at the cited coordinates. Each is a distinct investment row with a reported fair value, including negative fair values for the Jupiter delayed-draw row. The flag records zero matching pipeline rows for these eight source positions, so the source schedule count of eight versus observed output count of zero establishes a missing-position extraction gap. No aggregate companyfacts anchor was needed.
